name: FAQ — Apploom
html:
Questions, answered

Do I need to know how to code?

No. Describe what you want in plain language and Apploom generates a working full-stack app. You can still open the code if you want to fine-tune it.

What can I actually build?

Dashboards, internal tools, landing pages, small marketplaces — anything with a frontend, a database, and some logic in between.

Can I use my own design?

Yes. Import a Figma file and Apploom rebuilds it as real, editable components rather than a static picture.

What happens to the apps I build?

Every project gets a live URL you can share immediately, and you can connect a custom domain on paid plans.

Can my team work on the same project?

Team and Enterprise plans add shared projects, centralised billing, and role-based access.

name: FAQ — Kirja
html:
FAQ

  • How secure is Kirja?

    Kirja is built with enterprise-grade permissions, encryption in transit and at rest, and full audit logging, so every workspace can enforce its own retention and access rules.

  • Which tools does Kirja connect to?

    Kirja connects to the file storage, chat, email, calendar, CRM, and code tools most companies already run, with permissions synced in real time.

  • Can Kirja browse the web?

    Yes. Kirja can pull in current information from the open web and will always show which sources it used to build an answer.

  • How is my data stored?

    Your content stays inside your workspace and is never used to train shared models. You can set retention windows per data source.

  • Which language models does Kirja use?

    Kirja supports several leading models and lets admins choose which ones are available to their organization.

  • How long does setup take?

    Most teams connect their core tools and are answering real questions inside Kirja within a single afternoon.
